About Us

A Legacy of Islamic Scholarship in Lahore

Founded in September 1947, just a month after the creation of Pakistan, Jamia Ashrafia Lahore stands as a testament to the enduring pursuit of Islamic knowledge and scholarship.

Our Story

Established by Maulana Mufti Muhammad Hassan (RA)

Established by the esteemed scholar and spiritual leader, Maulana Mufti Muhammad Hassan (RA) — a devoted disciple (Khalifa-e-Arshad) of Hakimul Ummat Maulana Ashraf Ali Thanwi (RA) — the institution has served as a premier seat of Islamic learning for over 75 years.

Driven by a “missionary spirit,” Jamia Ashrafia has dedicated itself to fostering a deep understanding of Islamic principles and cultivating humanitarian values among its students and alumni. Thousands of scholars have graduated from its hallowed halls, carrying the torch of Islamic knowledge across the globe.

Jamia Ashrafia has expanded its reach through ten additional branches in Lahore, further strengthening its mission of providing authentic Islamic education.

Our Departments

The endless opportunity to acquire knowledge

Enlightening the world through the illumination and brightness of Islamic learning.

01

Dars-e-Nizami

An eight-year curriculum of Arabic and religious studies, delivered across four stages of two years each.

02

Hifz & Nazra

Under the supervision of highly qualified faculty, producing hafiz-e-Quran who recite with proper Tajweed.

03

Mahad-ul-Qurra

Equipping students with modern IT skills and language proficiency through the online education system.

04

Madrassa Faisla-lil-Banaat

Established in 1975, empowering women through authentic Islamic education.

05

Darul Ifta

Answering the public's Shar'i questions on worship, transactions, and family matters.

06

Ashrafia Welfare Trust

Extending charitable and medical assistance to deserving individuals and families.

07

Islamic Library

Access to a vast collection of Islamic literature and classical scholarly resources.

08

Ashrafia Medical Care

Healthcare services offered to students, staff, and the surrounding community.

09

Ashrafia E-Learning

A digital campus delivering Jamia's curriculum to students beyond Lahore.
